storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry place for a few months; refrigerate in hot, humid Mumbai weather to keep them soft and avoid insects.
looksLike: Small, wrinkled, oval dried grapes, green-gold to light amber, soft and sticky and seedless. Black raisins (kali kishmish) are a different, darker product.
howToPick: Plump, soft, evenly golden-green and not rock hard; no white sugar crust, mould or sour smell. Very dark, hard or sticky-clumped raisins are old.
shelfLife: Several months in a sealed pack (general guidance, not from a source this run).
substitutes: Dried cranberries or chopped dried apricots
